subject: Request: short interim eval extension while procurement completes
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Gara Patel <gara@healthlytics.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — short interim extension while PO clears

Hi Gara,

Thanks again for the time earlier today — great to see the HealthLytics team try the Redwood sandbox. I understand your procurement team has the PO queued but that it might take another week or two to route.

To avoid losing momentum on the evaluation, would you like us to provision a short, conditional extension (14 days) and a small token top-up so your data scientists can finish the last tests? We can issue this as a provisional addendum tied to Deal HL-2029-54. Conditions: we ask that HealthLytics share the PO number when available and that the PO arrives within 30 days of the extension start.

If that works I’ll loop in finance for a one-off approval and send a short addendum to sign. I’ve attached a one-page provisional top-up summary for internal review (attachment: provisional-topup-stub.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm you want the extension
- I submit internal approval request (cc’ing Camila and Kim)
- We send the addendum and confirm token allocation

Appreciate the quick confirmation so we can keep the sandbox warm.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

—
Attachment: provisional-topup-stub.pdf (1 page summary — tokens and dates)

From: Gara Patel <gara@healthlytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@healthlytics.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short interim extension while PO clears

Hi Sean,

Yes please — that would be helpful. Procurement flagged that the PO will be approved but it’s stuck at a signatory step and may not clear for 7–12 business days.

Two asks from our side: 1) can you provide a one-line written confirmation of the extension terms so I can forward to our procurement lead, and 2) we need a short quote line (amount and description) for our internal justification. I’m cc’ing AP to keep them in the loop.

If you send that over I’ll push it through on our end.

Thanks,
Gara
Gara Patel
Head of Data Products, HealthLytics
gara@healthlytics.com

(Attachment: none)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: approval request — 14-day extension + token top-up for HealthLytics (HL-2029-54)

Camila / Kim —

HealthLytics (Gara Patel) asked for a short 14-day eval extension and a modest token top-up while their PO clears (expected 7–12 business days). Gara needs a one-line confirmation and a quote amount to pass to procurement. Deal HL-2029-54.

Why: high intent, advanced POC, likely to convert to Dedicated within 90 days.

Proposed commercial:
- 14-day extension starting 2027-09-04
- 45,000 token top-up (sufficient for final model comparison and integration tests)
- No charge if PO is received within 30 days; otherwise top-up billed at standard eval rate.

I’ve attached a draft quote for review (draft-quote-HL-54.pdf). Can we approve this as a one-time courtesy to preserve momentum?

If approved I’ll send Gara the written confirmation + the quote and attach an addendum link for signature.

Thanks — Sean

—
Attachment: draft-quote-HL-54.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: approval request — 14-day extension + token top-up for HealthLytics (HL-2029-54)

Sean / Camila —

Approved with conditions. We can authorize a 14-day extension and the 45,000 token provisional top-up subject to the following:
1) HealthLytics must provide PO number within 30 days of the extension start (2027-09-04).
2) If the PO is not received within 30 days, the provisional top-up will be invoiced at the standard eval rate and payment terms net 30.
3) This is a one-time courtesy tied to Deal HL-2029-54 and does not set precedent; please note in the deal record.

I’ve uploaded the short approval memo as a document (temp-credit-approval.docx) — use that as the internal attachment when sending confirmation.

Kimberly Park
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

—
Attachment: temp-credit-approval.docx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Gara Patel <gara@healthlytics.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed — 14-day eval extension and provisional tokens (Deal HL-2029-54)

Hi Gara —

Thanks — we’re set. Per Kimberly’s approval, Redwood will:
- Activate a 14-day extension starting 2027-09-04 for HealthLytics’ sandbox
- Provision a 45,000 token top-up to the account as a provisional, one-time credit
- Conditions: please send the PO number within 30 days of 2027-09-04; if the PO is not provided within 30 days the top-up will be invoiced at standard eval rates (net 30).

I’ve attached the short quote and the approval memo for procurement to review (links below):
- Draft quote: https://drive.reddemo.example.com/HL-2029-54/draft-quote-HL-54.pdf
- Approval memo/addendum (signable): https://drive.reddemo.example.com/HL-2029-54/addendum

Gara — if you confirm here I’ll flip the switch and follow up with the addendum for signature. Appreciate you moving this through on your side.

Best,
